title: Thornback

steps.prompt: A stocky boar-like beast with a ridge of long wooden thorns along its back, mossy green-brown fur, short bark-coloured tusks, lowered head ready to charge, side-on three-quarter view. A single creature alone, centred, whole body in frame with margin, neutral standing pose, three-quarter front view, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no scenery. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 15000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 1.60 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/concepts/con_thornback.png.
